newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares close lower, DRB-Hicom down on requote.
newsitem.headline: KL shares close lower, DRB-Hicom down on requote.

text.p: Malaysian shares closed lower led by selling of stocks in the DRB-Hicom group following their requotation, dealers said.
Heavy share deliveries from last week also pressured the market, they said.
"As expected, the requotation of the group pulled down the market," said one institutional dealer. "But selling slowed in the afternoon and the stocks managed some rebound."
At the close, the benchmark Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks was down 13.73 points or 1.1 percent at 1,237.48.
Shares of the DRB-Hicom group were requoted after having been suspended since Tuesday following the death of its chairman Yahaya Ahmad in a helicopter crash.
Diversified Resources, Hicom, Proton, Edaran Otomobil Nasional and Gadek Malaysia fell between 10 and 50 cents each.
Dealers said heavy share deliveries this week were likely to cap market gains.
Market volume was 481 million shares. At the close, losers outnumbered gainers 408 to 203.
